scripts.quality:frontend: pnpm -C apps/desktop typecheck && pnpm -C apps/desktop lint && pnpm -C apps/desktop test && pnpm -C apps/desktop web:build
scripts.quality:rust: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.quality:python: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy && uv run pytest -q
scripts.quality: pnpm run quality:frontend && pnpm run quality:rust && pnpm run quality:python
